messages:
alex: Hey team — need approval and help filing GCP quota increase across multiple billing projects. We're onboarding a new customer and need mixed accelerators + NAT IPs in three regions. TL;DR: A100, H100, L4 counts + private service connect setup + egress NAT increase.

alex: Projects: `rw-prod-us`, `rw-dedicated-eu`, `rw-research-apac` (separate billing hosts). Current quotas are exhausted for our intended pools. I ran quick checks below.

alex: Regions and ask:
- us-west1 (rw-prod-us): A100 (a100-80gb) +32 GPUs initially, prefer L4 fallback for burst.
- europe-west4 (rw-dedicated-eu): H100 +16 GPUs.
- asia-east2 (rw-research-apac): L4 +24 GPUs, TPU v4 small test: 4 nodes (optional).
- Shared need: increase external NAT IP quota for `rw-prod-us` host project by +30 (for ephemeral EIPs) and VPC peering routes increase for ps-connect.

alex: Commands I used:
```
# check accelerator quotas
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=rw-prod-us --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric | contains("A100"))'
# list enabled services
gcloud services list --project=rw-dedicated-eu
```

devon: rough cost check? Want to eyeball monthly committed spend before approving. :eyes:

alex: rough on-demand per-month estimate (ballpark, no sustained discounts):
- A100 x32 @ ~$2.5/hr -> ~ $57k/month (on-demand)
- H100 x16 @ ~$4/hr -> ~ $46k/month
- L4 x24 @ ~$0.8/hr -> ~ $13k/month
Add 10% network/ops = ~$12k -> total ~ $128k/mo hotpool. We'll pursue reserved commits later.

sara: Please attach billing CICD tag / cost center and clarify whether these live on the same shared VPC host. We need the billing owner (cost-center) for quota requests. Also link to customer contract if this triggers reserved capacity.

alex: Added billing tag: `cc:platform-ai`. Contract: internal share `https://redwood/docs/contracts/customers/ACME-2026` (restricted). We plan to use shared VPC host `rw-cloud-host` for prod and dedicated pools; research is in a separate billing project but will peer into the host.

kai: Two quick asks: 1) We should request Private Service Connect (PS Connect) endpoints for the TPU API and for internal image pulls to avoid egress. 2) Increase routes quota (VPC peering) and forwarding-rules quota if you plan to use external load balancers for model endpoints.

alex: Good call. I'll include in the form: enable Private Service Connect, increase `VpcPeerings` limit by +10, forwarding-rules +20.

devon: Do we need org admin sign-off for enabling PS Connect? Last time cloud security wanted the network diagram.

maria: Yep — security needs the diagram and an owner. @alex please attach the minimal network diagram (drawn in Miro or ascii) and list the service accounts that will need access. I can fast-track after that.

alex: Pasting quick ascii diagram: 
```
rw-cloud-host (shared VPC host)
  |- subnet-prod-us (us-west1)
  |- subnet-eu (europe-west4)
  |- NAT gateway (external NATs)
    -> ephemeral IPs x30 requested
peer -> rw-research-apac (separate billing)
PS Connect endpoints -> TPU API + Artifact Registry
```

infra-bot: Reminder: quota requests must include project number, billing account id, and IAM approver email. See https://infra.redwood/internal/gcp-quota-guide

alex: Project numbers: `rw-prod-us: 128901234`, `rw-dedicated-eu: 128901235`, `rw-research-apac: 128901236`. Billing account: `BILL-0A1B2C`. Approver email: maria@redwood.ai.

sara: Also include exact accelerator types in the request: `nvidia-a100-80gb`, `nvidia-h100-80gb`, `nvidia-l4`. GCP sometimes rejects vague names.

alex: noted. I'll submit the GCP quota form this afternoon. Draft of the description I'll paste into the request: "Capacity ramp for customer X: initial reserved inference pools across us-west1 (A100 x32), europe-west4 (H100 x16), asia-east2 (L4 x24). Additional network resources: +30 ephemeral external IPs, +10 VPC peerings, +20 forwarding rules. Enable Private Service Connect endpoints for TPU API and Artifact Registry. Project host: rw-cloud-host. Billing cc: platform-ai."

kai: If this goes to support, flag it as "production-impact" so we get faster review. Also add expected go-live date.

alex: Go-live planned 2026-05-15. Marked in the draft.

maria: Okay — after you submit the form ping me here with the GCP request ID. I'll sign and escalate to cloud billing/security. Once they ack we'll coordinate capacity allocation window. :+1:

devon: One more: can we attach a quick perf target? e.g., 10k rps aggregate, p50 <= 120ms generation tail for prod A100 pool. Helps support core team prioritize.

alex: Added perf note. I'll submit now and post the request id. Thanks all. :rocket:
